continuity_test.note: Visibility is held fixed; detector/image truncation is reported separately from the cubic interior response.

forward_detector_integral.brightness_invariance: N->aN multiplies the expected numerator by a and the explicit 1/N by 1/a

continuous_kernel.normalization: integral K_p(s) ds = 1 for interior pixels
continuous_kernel.pixel_area: DeltaA_normalized=1/(H W); the H W factor is reciprocal pixel area
continuous_kernel.resolution_semantics: a per-pixel reconstruction/aperture response whose normalized-detector width shrinks with resolution; this is the v0.8.2 matched-density control, not the v0.8.1 enlarged footprint

forward_detector_integral.detector_coordinates: s=(s_y,s_x) in [0,1)^2; r=s_y H-1/2 and c=s_x W-1/2
forward_detector_integral.estimator: Ihat_p = g/N sum_i f_i K_p(u_i), with q_z=1
forward_detector_integral.integral: I_p = g integral_[0,1)^4 f(T_F(z),omega_v) K_p(u(T_F(z))) dz
forward_detector_integral.jacobian: dI_p/dlambda=g/N sum_i[(df_i/dlambda)K_p(u_i)+f_i grad(K_p)(u_i) dot du_i/dlambda], with visibility and root/path ownership frozen
forward_detector_integral.prototype_scope: A mathematically coherent integral of the current transported attribute under its algorithmic sampling measure, not a calibrated physical radiance or irradiance estimator.

sample_variables.omega_i: one fixed Fibonacci-atlas direction for each detector view
sample_variables.q_i: q_z(z)=1 on [0,1)^4; the surface-space push-forward density is not assumed area-uniform
sample_variables.u_i: orthographic normalized detector coordinate of x_i
sample_variables.x_i: Newton/fallback projection T_F(z_i) onto a sign-changing grid cell
sample_variables.z_i: four-dimensional point in [0,1)^4 from a Sobol scramble

sampling_audit.attenuation: no inverse-square or distance attenuation; intentionally absent in this prototype
sampling_audit.cell_choice: floor(z0 * number_of_sign_changing_cells), hence uniform cell probability 1/M
sampling_audit.direction_pdf: none in the per-view estimator; omega_v is a deterministic view/packet direction
sampling_audit.normal_weight: normal affects outward acceptance and the declared cosine appearance lobe
sampling_audit.packet_weight: one unit latent sample per emitter per view
sampling_audit.surface_area_pdf: not available and not silently approximated
sampling_audit.visibility: hard first-zero-set ownership with intersection epsilon 2e-4
sampling_audit.within_cell: z1,z2,z3 are uniform voxel coordinates before zero-set projection

forward_detector_integral.sobol_note: scrambled Sobol is randomized QMC, so iid 1/N variance is a reference rather than an asserted exact rate
forward_detector_integral.variance: Var[Ihat_p]=g^2 Var[fK_p]/N for iid latent samples

four_estimators.CONTINUOUS_KERNEL_MONTE_CARLO: g H W/N sum_i f_i B(r_p-r_i)B(c_p-c_i) (unclamped measurement)
four_estimators.HARD_BIN_MONTE_CARLO: g H W/N sum_i f_i 1[u_i in pixel p] (unclamped measurement)
four_estimators.semantic_distinction: LEGACY_GATED_NORMALIZED_SPLAT and UNGATED_NORMALIZED_SPLAT reconstruct a local transported attribute; HARD_BIN_MONTE_CARLO and CONTINUOUS_KERNEL_MONTE_CARLO estimate detector-density integrals under the declared latent measure.
